text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy dominates the<n>February Stakes. The
spectators who<n>once refused to take her seriously
are left speechless by her impressive<n>performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She and Biko Pegasus commend<n>each other's
running, and<n>acknowledge that they've become
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Public perception has begun to shift,<n>but only by a
fraction. Hoping to use a<n>G1 race to further
showcase her<n>talent, Shinko Windy sets her sights
on the Teio Sho.
